author: vonderleyen
text:
I condemn the Houthi attack against Saudi Arabia.

We stand in solidarity with our Gulf partners in the face of relentless attacks by Iran’s proxies.

We will continue working with our partners for safe, free navigation through the Strait of Hormuz and for stability in the Middle East.

We all have a stake in this.
